method: 20 sequential POST /v1/rag/query with ticker=AAPL from cold Ollama state
note: This is the second 20-query run of Phase 0D. The first run (commit eda0d30, before the log-render fix in b6725cf) produced 2/20 HTTP 422, both malformed_json, but the gateway log held zero grep-able raw_ollama_response_snippet entries because no Formatter in this codebase renders extra={} fields into log text -- discovered when the Task 1F grep came back empty. b6725cf fixed the log statement to also interpolate the fields into the message string via %-style formatting. This run was captured after that fix and after a fresh gateway restart + cold Ollama reload, with gateway log at /tmp/gateway_phase0d.log (truncated before this run started).

queries.classification_detail: Raw body is complete, syntactically valid JSON (finish_reason visibly reaches 'sto'[p] within the 500-char window, confirming natural completion, not truncation). The model invented a placeholder citation chunk_id ('abc-123') that does not exist among the retrieved chunks. The schema rail's citation cross-check correctly caught it. Not a JSON-parsing failure; not covered by the empty/truncated_json/empty_answer_field buckets.

queries.classification_detail: Rail's own reason is malformed_json (json.loads on content raised). Snippet cuts off mid-string inside the citations array quote field with no closing quote/brace/bracket -- consistent with generation stopping before the JSON structure closed, not a different-shaped error. raw_response_length=999 is within the 500-char logged window only partially (we log [:500] of the raw envelope; content itself is longer), so this reflects the structural shape of the cut, not solely our own display truncation.

queries.note: Downstream timeout/retry exhaustion (circuit-breaker budget path), not a schema-rail block. No schema_rail_block log entry exists for this query. Out of scope for the 422 classification task but recorded for completeness.

queries.classification_detail: Same pattern as query 8: malformed_json reason, snippet cuts off mid third-citation object with an unterminated key, no closing delimiters.

Complete, valid JSON. hallucinated_ids=['7f83307f1ac6a79'] is a one-character near-miss of the real retrieved chunk_id '57f83307f1ac6a79' (missing leading '5') -- the model paraphrased/mistyped a real ID rather than fabricating or omitting content. Caught correctly by the citation cross-check, not a JSON-parsing failure.

characterization: 4 observed HTTP 422s in 20 queries (plus 1 unrelated HTTP 504 downstream timeout, not a schema-rail block). Of the 4 422s: 2 are truncated_json (malformed_json reason, raw body visibly cuts off mid-structure with no closing delimiters) and 2 are 'other' -- hallucinated_citation blocks on complete, valid JSON where the model cited a nonexistent or near-miss chunk_id. Zero observed 'empty' or 'empty_answer_field' cases in this run, which is the specific failure mode Phase 0B originally flagged (1/5 queries, empty answer field) -- that exact mode was not reproduced here or in the first Phase 0D run. This is an observed count from one 20-query run, not a projected production rate.

prior_run_for_comparison.note: First Phase 0D 20-query run (before the b6725cf log-render fix; gateway log had no usable raw_ollama_response_snippet entries, so classification here relies on the schema rail's own details.raw_snippet from the HTTP error body, a separate pre-existing mechanism).
prior_run_for_comparison.both_422s_classification: truncated_json (raw_snippet cuts off mid-string with no closing delimiter in both cases)

latency_anomaly_note: Queries 12 and 14-19 show latencies of 22-47s despite being 'warm' Ollama state, versus 4-14s for queries 2-11. Observed, not investigated further -- out of Phase 0D Task 1 scope (stopping rule: no follow-on investigations).
